assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is performed with CPT code 93229.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate transient symptoms with potential arrhythmic events or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
Standard ambulatory monitoring may not capture the transient symptoms.
Advance approval for the diagnostic procedure is warranted to establish medical necessity as required by plan guidelines.
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197.
CO-197 indicates that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for the diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
The denial of the required precertification is erroneous given the documented clinical indication.
